correctness.rationale: Parseval for P³ gives seven cubic-convolution coefficients; their squared moduli bound by the positive-modulus triangle envelope. Writing u=|a|²+|c|², v=|ac|, t=|b|², the envelope derivative with respect to v is 12t²+18tu+12v(3t+u) nonnegative, so AM–GM forces |a|=|c| at each nondegenerate maximum. Put |b|/|a|=r and s=r²; the sixth-power ratio is (s³+30s²+90s+20)/(s+2)³. Independent SymPy differentiation verifies derivative -12(2s²+5s−10)/(s+2)^4 and its unique nonnegative optimum s=(sqrt105−5)/4, giving exactly 35(sqrt105−3)/48. Equality of all triangle steps forces phase relation b²/(ac)>0 and hence the stated complete complex family. Saved source verifier was read and independently repeated key symbolic identities, not relied on as a universal proof.
